mentions.name: Tasty A.F.
mentions.description: This app turns any online recipe URL into a printable 3x5 index card. Users paste a recipe link, AI scrapes the page and generates a concise card with the essentials, which can be printed and kept in the kitchen while cooking. Built with Python/Flask and the Anthropic Claude API, hosted on Railway.
mentions.problem: Cooking from internet recipes means scrolling past long stories to find the ingredient list, then trying to read it off a phone with wet hands.
mentions.audience: People who cook from the internet and want quick, readable recipes in the kitchen.
